hotel.name: Grand Palace Hotel
hotel.description: A modern luxury hotel offering comfortable rooms, dining, wellness, business facilities, events, and 24/7 guest services.

checkInAndCheckOut.earlyCheckIn: Subject to availability. Guests may request early check-in at the front desk.
checkInAndCheckOut.lateCheckOut: Subject to availability and may involve an additional charge.

roomInformation.extraBed: Available in selected rooms subject to availability and additional charges.
roomInformation.babyCrib: Available on request at no additional charge.
roomInformation.connectingRooms: Available on request subject to availability.
roomInformation.smokingRooms: Smoking is not permitted inside guest rooms.
roomInformation.accessibleRooms: Accessible rooms are available on request.
roomInformation.turndownService: Available on request for selected room categories.
roomInformation.minibar: Available in Deluxe Rooms, Executive Rooms, Suites, and Presidential Suite.

roomDining.note: Guests can order food and beverages directly to their rooms.

services.luggageStorage: Available before check-in and after check-out

airportPickup.note: Guests should contact the hotel before arrival to arrange airport pickup.

parking.reservation: Parking does not require advance reservation.

payment.advancePayment: Some bookings may require advance payment.
payment.securityDeposit: A refundable security deposit may be required at check-in.
payment.taxes: Applicable government taxes are added to the room rate.

booking.recommendedBookingMethod: Guests can book through the hotel's official booking channel or contact reservations.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in.
policies.lateCancellation: Late cancellation may result in a cancellation charge depending on the booking terms.
policies.noShow: No-show charges may apply according to the reservation terms.
policies.smoking: Smoking is not permitted inside guest rooms or indoor public areas.
policies.parties: Parties are not permitted inside guest rooms.
policies.quietHours: Guests are requested to maintain quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM.
policies.outsideFood: Outside food may be subject to hotel policies.
policies.identification: Valid government-issued identification is required at check-in.

accessibility.note: Guests requiring accessibility assistance should inform the hotel before arrival.

events.note: Guests can contact the events team for availability, packages, and pricing.

guestSupport.lostAndFound: Guests can contact the front desk regarding lost belongings.
guestSupport.medicalAssistance: The front desk can assist guests in contacting nearby medical services.
guestSupport.emergency: For emergencies, contact the front desk immediately.
guestSupport.specialRequests: Special requests are subject to availability and should be communicated before arrival whenever possible.
guestSupport.complaints: Guests can contact the front desk or concierge for assistance with complaints or service issues.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does the hotel have free Wi-Fi?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, the hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and a heated indoor pool.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does the hotel have a gym?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, the fitness center is available 24/7.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Is breakfast included?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Breakfast is available, but it is not included by default. The listed price is ₹800 per person.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Is parking available?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, both valet and self-parking are available. Additional charges may apply.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does the hotel provide airport pickup?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, airport pickup is available with advance booking.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Can I cancel my booking?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before check-in, subject to booking terms.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Can I check in early?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Early check-in is subject to availability. Guests can request it at the front desk.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Can I check out late?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Late check-out is subject to availability and may involve an additional charge.

importantInstructionsForAI.unknownInformationResponse: I'm sorry, I don't have that information in the hotel's current information. Please contact the front desk or reservations team for assistance.
importantInstructionsForAI.answerStyle: Be friendly, concise, professional, and helpful. Give direct answers and mention relevant details when useful.
